text: hm its still one mesh. but this thing auto saves so uh idk but there is probably a necessary un-fuck script needed for this very moment
resolution: Diagnosed the live data incident and closed the destructive write path. Paint/atlas persistence was incorrectly routed through the full model-artifact writer without Outliner metadata, allowing doc.blob to be rewritten with rangeCount=0; the next load projected one fallback Cube 1 row and autosave then overwrote parts.json with that projection. The user chose to move on rather than repair this model. No Heroin_Bob_head asset file was modified; a read-only evidence copy remains under /tmp/heroin-bob-head-recovery.GtNKan.
